notes.title: HARD MODE and PERMA DEATH now available!
notes.content:
The much requested HARD MODE and PERMA DEATH modes are now in game for you to play!

Hard mode has the following changes:
- Increased monster HP
- Increased miniboss HP
- Increased Boss HP
- Increased enemy attack power for melee and spells
- Increased enemy spell rate
- Lower sell prices
- Higher buy prices
- Pets morph power is lower
- Pets have slightly lower HP
- Pets have lower capture rate
- Pets have lower attack


It is recommended to start a new game to make use of these modes, although you can upgrade your current game save to "Hard Mode" by following these instructions:

To upgrade your game to "hard mode" - enter your game and then go to options->command and enter "hardmode"

See the full post here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1154850/discussions/0/2998795613909519463/

notes.title: Zoomable Map
notes.content:
You can now zoom in/out map using the buttons on the full map.

You can navigate around this map using WASD for keyboard (or your assigned movement buttons) or the Right Stick using gamepad.

I can make small improvements to this where possible, but please note a fully interactive zoomable map with x10000 features is probably never going to happen lol.

Some more fixes this patch:
- PC - Full map - ensure doesnt scale with GUI Scaling
- Yenderh shiny card count fixed
- Quest log - Curfian quest now shows correct NPC name (Blinmo)
- Shadow guild shows "Tick" icon on fullmap
- Sync world map to allow for Krinsor Dam changes

Thank you!

notes.title: Quality of life and other fixes!
notes.content:
The new 1.30 patch is now available! It includes some Quality of Life features and fixes.

- Move all creatures to storage button - you can now instantly put all your pet creatures into storage! This helps massively when trying to capture a new one!

- Perma delete creature button (from storage) - Good bye rubbish creature! You can now manage your storage better by permanently deleting a creature! BE CAREFUL...!

- Show Ladders on dungeon maps - This one will make the game a bit easier (sorry for whoever liked it that way) but a large majority of people are getting lost. As a little gesture towards improving maps, I've started by adding ladder locations to the dungeon maps. 

- Added 1600x900 resolution - Launcher now includes this much requested resolution!

- Autosort puts equipped items at front - I think a few people requested this and it makes sense - using the Autosort button will put your equipped items at the front!

Some smaller fixes:
- Khennle quest gives correct dialogue after
- Fyued quest "Beat everyone in Rhunden" fixed
- Fishing skill EXP gain increased a lot


Thank you!

notes.title: Re-bindable Keyboard controls now in
notes.content:
I have implemented a simple method to rebind the buttons on keyboard. Please note this feature is fairly experimental - in that, it is functional, with a few limitations. I wanted to just include it as soon as it was functional to allow people to use it if the default controls made the game unplayable.

The limitations are:
- The game graphics are NOT updated. Ie.  it will still say "Press E to interact" even if you bind with "G"

- The player has no accerlation/decelleration. They just run at full speed instantly (minor cosmetic)

- The interface requires you to just input a button 1 at a time, as instructed - instead of a list. This will most likely not change, as it is the simplest way to implement a feature that you are likely only ever going to use once, after that it will autosave/load the settings and you never have to do it again.


Thank you! If you have problems, please let me know.
